DECLARE @DatetoProcessed DATE
SET @DatetoProcessed = '2023-01-01'
IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'ACCOUNT_DEP') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.ACCOUNT_DEP;
END;

WITH ACCOUNT_SK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountSk),0) RN FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT 

)

SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM ACCOUNT_SK) AS AccountSK, * 
INTO DW.ACCOUNT_DEP
FROM 
(SELECT DISTINCT
BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
,CASE
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCA.CustomerAccountClosedDate <= CONVERT(DATE,@DatetoProcessed) AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA') 
     THEN 'Closed'
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'N' AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('CAA', 'SBA') 
     THEN BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCA.CustomerAccountClosedDate > CONVERT(DATE,@DatetoProcessed) AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('CAA', 'SBA') 
     THEN BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCA.CustomerAccountClosedDate > CONVERT(DATE,@DatetoProcessed) AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('TDA') 
     THEN  BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'N' AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('TDA') 
     THEN BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     END AS AccountStatus 
,CASE 
     WHEN BCAF.ProductId IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
     THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBRAN.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm

FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,CustomerAccountClosedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount where SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' ) BCA 
JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMERACCOUNTID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId,PERIODENDDATE,ProductId,FINANCIALPRODUCTID,FcbsApplication,PeriodStartDate FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct  ) BCAF ON convert(varchar,BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) = convert(varchar,BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode  AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId AND CONVERT(DATE,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate) = CONVERT(DATE,BCAF.PeriodStartDate)  
LEFT JOIN (SELECT FinancialProductId,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId,FcbsApplicationId FROM DW.FINPRODAPP) FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAF.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = FPA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode,ClosedAccountIndicator FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'  ) BCCACCT ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCACCT.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCACCT.FinancialInstitutionId  AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCACCT.SourceSystemCode
--LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,DepositAccountStatusTypeId FROM BNKM.DepositAccountStatus WHERE PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL) BDAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BDAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BDAS.FinancialInstitutionId 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ORDER BY PeriodStartTimeStamp desc) rn, CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,DepositAccountStatusTypeId FROM BNKM.DepositAccountStatus WHERE  @DatetoProcessed between PeriodStartTimeStamp and replace(isnull(PeriodEndTimeStamp,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31')) BDAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BDAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BDAS.FinancialInstitutionId  AND BDAS.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMERACCOUNTID,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,SourceSystemCode,EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator FROM DW.CORECUSTACCPYROLL WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') BCCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND DDBRAN.CurrentIndicator = 1 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode,ProfitCostCenterId FROM DW.CoreCustAccProCostCenter WHERE ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1' AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCC.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
AND BCAF.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
AND BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate <= CONVERT(DATE,@DatetoProcessed)
)A
